    Efficient tackles and the hypothesis (K') #

    Fischbacher's tackles end in an arrow lying in an essential contour (RayCat.InEss). For an efficient tackle whose last link is a valley, with last arrow β and previous entry τ, replacing β by any arrow γ ≰ τ lying in an essential contour gives an efficient tackle again, so the key lemma shows (K'): such γ occur in essential contours only first (RayCat.keyProp_of_efficient). Efficient tackles exist in finite chain-bounded ray categories with an essential contour (RayCat.exists_efficient).
